title: subagent: Find FRB papers and time spans

content:
I need to find two specific papers about fast radio bursts (FRBs) and determine the difference in measured time span (in seconds) between two diagrams.

Paper 1 (March 2021): About multiwavelength observations of FRBs with an X-ray time profile diagram.
Paper 2 (July 2020): By one of the same authors, about FRBs with a "burst-1" diagram.

Please use webfetch to:
1. Search arXiv at https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph/recent or use the arXiv API at http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=... 
2. Find the March 2021 paper - likely about FRB 121102 or similar, with multiwavelength observations including X-ray
3. Find the July 2020 paper by overlapping authors
4. Access the PDF or abstract pages to identify the time spans in the X-ray time profile diagrams
5. Calculate the difference in seconds

Some known FRB researchers to consider: Bart Spitler, Laura Spitler, Kenzie Nimmo, Kiyoshi Masui, Joeri van Leeuwen, Vikas Ravi, Shunsaku Horiuchi, et al.

Report the exact paper titles, arXiv IDs, the time spans in each diagram, and the difference.
I'll search for these FRB papers systematically. Let me start by querying the arXiv API for relevant papers from March 2021 and July 2020.
